summary: Impersonation feature testing complete. Backend tests: 7/8 passed (1 skipped). Frontend UI: All 5 features verified working. Super Admin can successfully impersonate a vendor to create tickets on their behalf.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend server.py (lines 1183-1205): Impersonation logic correctly validates super_admin role and gets target user
Backend server.py (line 1355): 'impersonated_by' field correctly tracks which admin created the ticket
Frontend seller-profile.tsx (lines 390-400): Impersonate button correctly shows only for super_admin users
Frontend impersonate.tsx (lines 173-175): Warning banner 'Modo Suplantación Activo' displays in orange
Frontend multi-play.tsx (lines 487-493): Impersonation banner shows 'Creando ticket como: [Name]' when actAs parameter present
Frontend multi-play.tsx (lines 442-443): act_as_user_id correctly sent to backend when in impersonation mode
context_for_next_testing_agent: Impersonation feature fully tested and working. Backend accepts act_as_user_id in POST /api/tickets/multi. Frontend shows impersonation banners correctly. The impersonate button appears on seller-profile.tsx for super_admin users only.

Impersonate Button on Seller Profile.notes: Button 'Actuar como [Name]' appears on seller profile for Super Admin. Uses data-testid='impersonate-button'. Orange colored button with person-circle icon.

Impersonate Screen (/impersonate).notes: Screen shows orange warning banner 'Modo Suplantación Activo' and header 'Actuando como: [Name]'. Has action cards for 'Vender' and 'Multi-Jugada'. Shows seller's balance and recent tickets.

Multi-Play Navigation with actAs Paramet.notes: Clicking 'Multi-Jugada' button navigates to /multi-play?actAs=[sellerId]&actAsName=[sellerName]. URL correctly contains impersonation parameters.

Multi-Play Impersonation Banner.notes: Multi-play screen shows orange banner 'Creando ticket como: [Name]' when actAs parameter is present. Banner has warning icon.

Backend Impersonation (POST /api/tickets.notes: Backend accepts act_as_user_id parameter. Creates ticket with seller's ID. Updates seller's stats (sales, commission, balance). Records 'impersonated_by' in ticket document.

security_verified.only_super_admin_can_impersonate: Verified - non-super_admin users get 403 Forbidden when trying to use act_as_user_id
security_verified.invalid_user_id_returns_404: Verified - using fake user ID returns 404 Not Found
